setup-laravel.description: composer setup — install, migrate, seed, build in web_baagicha/
setup-laravel.prompt: Run `composer setup` inside web_baagicha/ to install dependencies, generate app key, migrate database, seed, and build frontend assets.

dev-laravel.description: Start Laravel dev environment (server + queue + pail + vite)
dev-laravel.prompt: Run `composer dev` inside web_baagicha/ to start all dev servers concurrently.

test-react.prompt: Run `npm test` inside baagichaApp/ to run Jest tests.
